_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Demonstrates simultaneous high-speed coherent communication (60 GBaud 16-QAM) and sub-meter vibration sensing (DAS) using LFM probes embedded in data frame headers.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Frame structure with LFM sensing pilots in ISAC header. Fig 2: Shared Transmitter setup for Coherent Comms & Sensing. Fig 3: 0.5m resolution peak and BER tradeoff.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Coherent Fiber ISAC. Sensing: DAS (phi-OTDR via LFM pilots). Comm: Coherent 16-QAM. Method: Time/Frequency multiplexing LFM probes into roll-off area of training sequences.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 60 GBaud (~240 Gbps raw). Sensing: 0.5m spatial resolution over 10 km. Negligible BER impact at STPR < 6dB.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Highly efficient resource sharing (Spectrum & Hardware). Uses LFM for high-resolution sensing without dedicated channels.

bibliographic.title: High-efficiency ISAC to enable sub-meter level vibration sensing for coherent fiber networks
bibliographic.authors: Jingchuan Wang, Liwang Lu, Li Wang, Yaxi Yan, Alan Pak Tao Lau, Chao Lu

application.scenario_description: Sub-meter vibration sensing integrated into 60 GBaud coherent fiber communication link.

key_contribution.key_contribution: LFM sensing probes embedded in communication frame headers (ISACH) for simultaneous high-res DAS and Coherent Comms.

transmitter.notes: 60 GBaud 16-QAM. LFM pilots added in Training Sequence.

receiver.notes: Coherent Receiver for both Comms (BPD) and Sensing (ICR).

integration.notes: Time-staggered LFM probes within frame structure. Shared spectrum (Roll-off area).

waveform.notes: Communication: 16-QAM. Sensing: LFM Chirp (250 MHz BW).

comm_metrics.notes: 60 GBaud * 4 bits/symbol = 240 Gbps. BER < FEC limit at STPR 6dB.

sensing_metrics.notes: 0.5m spatial resolution. 21 dB SNR for vibration sensing.

tradeoff.notes: Sensing Power vs Comm BER tradeoff. Optimal STPR ~6-8 dB.
